basic_profile.bio: I’m a 36-year-old graphic designer based in San Diego, California. My interests include exploring new technology trends, playing indie games, and understanding complex phenomena like long COVID. I dislike misinformation, particularly around health topics, and I find solace in structured discussions. Typically, I'm online in the evenings after work, around 7 to 10 PM PST. I’m currently single, focusing on my career and personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and a keen interest in technology, which I keep updated on through online courses and forums. My understanding of COVID-19 and related health issues comes from extensive reading of medical articles and participation in related subreddits.
